verdict.rationale: Data region or residency is a fair question for a managed AI gateway that proxies and logs requests, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions choosing a storage region or residency. The `order`/`only`/`sort` provider-routing controls pick which provider handles a request, not where data is stored, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
